zh-CN.title: 色与空
zh-CN.subtitle: 短句、经文结构与解释史
zh-CN.shortSummary: “色与空”是《心经》最常被引用的表达之一，但它必须放回具体版本、段落结构和般若语境中理解。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把概念卡、段落卡和版本卡分开，让观众先看到原文与定位，再进入比较和解释。
不同传统可以被并置讨论，但不能因为都有“空”“道”或“礼”等翻译词就被当作同一套思想。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充异本、译者归属、汉译术语史和不同传统之间比较的学术出处。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 经文概念；隋唐传播重点

en.title: Form and emptiness
en.subtitle: A short phrase, textual structure and histories of interpretation
en.shortSummary: Form and emptiness is one of the Heart Sutra's most cited expressions, but it must be read within a specific version, passage structure and Prajnaparamita context.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates concept, passage and version cards so visitors see the wording and locator before entering comparison and interpretation.
Traditions can be placed side by side without treating shared translated words such as emptiness, Dao or ritual as one system of thought.
en.researchNote: Variant readings, translator attribution, the history of Chinese terminology and scholarship on cross-tradition comparison still need citations.
